## Exact stationary reduction

At a stationary ATPase-off state, K and Cl have no active work input. Their
channel/cotransport dissipations are nonnegative. Stationary K/Cl amounts and
IK+ICl=0 make the sum of those dissipations zero; positive leak conductances
therefore require

    Vm=EK=ECl, JKCl=0,
    r=exp(-F Vm/(RT))=Ki/Ke=Cle/Cli.                  (1)

This is a consequence of the declared passive transport network. It is not a
grant of independent K and Cl setpoints. Write intracellular/extracellular
water volumes w and u=Vtotal-w, and total K/Cl amounts Ktot/Cltot. Then

    nKi=Ktot r w/(r w+u),
    nCli=Cltot w/(w+r u),
    q=C Vm/F,
    nNai=Ai-nKi+nCli+q.                             (2)

Here q is expressed in fmol with the source pF/mV units. Equal osmotic pressures
give

    (nNai+nKi+nCli+Ai)/w = Omega_total/Vtotal.        (3)

Equations2/3 reduce the stationary composition to one scalar volume root at
each Vm. The required Imax then follows from I_R=-I_Na with actual stationary
source gate probabilities. `light_ion_stationary_curve.py` independently checks
the resulting full cell RHS; selected residuals are below3.2e-10 in its stated
mixed source coordinates.

For the declared finite bath and30kJ/mol pump law, native NaV gives static folds
at Vm=-58.7179mV,Imax=86.5029pA and Vm=-42.0929mV,Imax=327.1830pA.
At10% NaV permeability the folds are76.8953/84.0147pA; full NaV suppression
removes these folds in the sampled physical voltage interval. This explains a
large load created by the native NaV window rather than merely by Na leak.
These are folds of the exact STATIC curve. They do not alone prove stability,
a global basin boundary, a minimal arbitrary waveform, or a biological current
threshold.

A pure outward-Na pump with passive K/Cl cannot exactly maintain the ordinary
healthy resting state: at that state Vm is above EK and K leaks outward. The
pump-maintained states lie on a different stationary relation. Active K return,
a different transporter network or eventual ordinary ATPase support is required
for the complete healthy operation; none is supplied by labeling silencing as
repair.

class LightCell:
    def __init__(self,current_max_pa=100.,km_na_mm=5.,drive_j_mol=30000.,
                 initial_cell=None,allocation=.5):
        self.bath=f.ClosedBath(allocation=allocation,initial_cell=initial_cell)
        self.current_max=current_max_pa;self.km=km_na_mm;self.drive=drive_j_mol
        if not 0<drive_j_mol<=PHOTON_MOLAR:raise ValueError('Drive exceeds supplied photon energy')

    def pump(self,y,light):
        ve,ce=self.bath.extracellular(y)
        na=y[4]*1000/y[7]
        cost=d.R*d.T*math.log(ce[0]/na)-d.F*y[0]*.001
        affinity=self.drive-cost
        # An explicitly added constitutive law. Positive-affinity turnover is
        # bounded by current_max and falls to zero at stall. This is not fitted
        # to a recorded KR2 I-V curve; the rate is not its transient peak.
        factor=-math.expm1(-max(0.,affinity)/(d.R*d.T))
        current=light*self.current_max*na/(self.km+na)*factor
        return current,cost,affinity

    def rhs(self,t,y,light=1.,metabolism=0.,nat=1.):
        dy=self.bath.rhs(t,y[:10],pump=metabolism,nat=nat)
        ip,cost,affinity=self.pump(y,light)
        j=ip*1000/d.F # fmol/s outward Na
        dy[0]-=ip/d.C*1000
        dy[4]-=j
        # n_export, delivered ion work, minimum productive photon energy.
        return np.r_[dy,j,j*1e-15*cost,j*1e-15*PHOTON_MOLAR]

    def integrate(self,y,seconds,light=1.,metabolism=0.,nat=1.,rtol=2e-7,samples=601):
        sol=solve_ivp(lambda t,z:self.rhs(t,z,light,metabolism,nat),(0.,seconds),y,
          method='BDF',rtol=rtol,
          atol=np.r_[1e-6,np.full(3,1e-9),np.full(3,1e-8),1e-5,1e-8,1e-8,1e-8,1e-18,1e-18],
          t_eval=np.linspace(0.,seconds,samples),max_step=5.)
        if not sol.success:raise RuntimeError(sol.message)
        return sol

    def describe(self,y):
        row=self.bath.describe(y[:10]);ip,cost,affinity=self.pump(y,1.)
        ve,ce=self.bath.extracellular(y)
        row.update(fully_lit_model_photocurrent_pa=ip,na_export_work_j_mol=cost,
          remaining_pump_affinity_j_mol=affinity,pump_na_export_fmol=y[10],
          pump_useful_ion_work_j=y[11],minimum_productive_photon_energy_j=y[12],
          k_reversal_mv=d.RTF*1000*math.log(ce[1]/row['k_mm']),
          cl_reversal_mv=-d.RTF*1000*math.log(ce[2]/row['cl_mm']))
        return {k:float(v) for k,v in row.items()}


def good_time(sol):
    na=sol.y[4]*1000/sol.y[7]

class Curve:
    def __init__(self,nat=1.,drive=30000.):
        self.cell=m.LightCell(current_max_pa=1.,drive_j_mol=drive)
        self.bath=self.cell.bath;self.nat=nat
        b=self.bath
        self.osm=(b.total_na+b.total_k+b.total_cl+d.NA_FIXED+b.external_a)/b.total_water

    def state(self,v):
        b=self.bath;r=math.exp(-v*.001/d.RTF);q=d.C*v/d.F
        def amounts(w):
            ve=b.total_water-w
            nk=b.total_k*r*w/(r*w+ve)
            nc=b.total_cl*w/(w+r*ve)
            nn=d.NA_FIXED-nk+nc+q
            return np.array([nn,nk,nc])
        def osmres(w):return (amounts(w).sum()+d.NA_FIXED)/w-self.osm
        w=brentq(osmres,1e-5,b.total_water-1e-8,xtol=1e-13)
        aa,bb=d.gates(v)
        return np.r_[v,aa/(aa+bb),amounts(w),w*1000,0.,0.,0.,0.,0.]

    def current(self,v):
        y=self.state(v);ve,ce=self.bath.extracellular(y)
        na=y[4]*1000/y[7];mm,hh,nn=y[1:4]
        ina=d.ghk(d.PNAL+d.PNAT*self.nat*mm**3*hh,na,ce[0],1,v)
        unit=self.cell.pump(y,1.)[0]
        return -ina/unit if unit>1e-12 else float('nan')

    def row(self,v):
        y=self.state(v);row=self.cell.describe(y);current=self.current(v)
        self.cell.current_max=current
        residual=self.cell.rhs(0,y,nat=self.nat)[:8]
        self.cell.current_max=1.
        row.update(required_current_max_pa=current,
             maximum_cell_stationary_rhs_residual=float(abs(residual).max()))
        return row
